# railway_bucket_credentials (Ephemeral Resource)

Fetches S3-compatible Railway bucket credentials without persisting the returned values in Terraform plan or state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
ephemeral "railway_bucket_credentials" "uploads" {
  project_id     = railway_bucket.uploads.project_id
  environment_id = railway_bucket_instance.uploads.environment_id
  bucket_id      = railway_bucket_instance.uploads.bucket_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket_id` (String) Identifier of the bucket.
- `environment_id` (String) Identifier of the environment.
- `project_id` (String) Identifier of the project.

### Read-Only

- `access_key_id` (String, Sensitive) S3 access key identifier.
- `bucket_name` (String) Globally unique S3 bucket name.
- `endpoint` (String) S3 endpoint.
- `region` (String) S3 region.
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) S3 secret access key.
- `url_style` (String) S3 URL style.
